title: LoL Esports
content:

The professional scene is an ever-evolving battleground where even the smallest adjustment can make or break a team's championship aspirations. Every coach, analyst, and player must stay ahead of the curve to remain competitive.

Speaking on the recent events, seasoned esports analysts noted that 'LoL Esports  LoL Esports' is not just a temporary trend but a fundamental shift in how teams will approach their upcoming matchdays. As the community awaits the upcoming weekend matches, anticipation continues to build. Fans can catch all the high-stakes action live on official streaming channels, complete with expert desk analysis and live regional broadcasts. title: Esports Charts Nominated for Esports Supporting Service of the Year
summary: Esports Charts Nominated for Esports Supporting Service of the Year  Esports Charts
content:
LIVE Viewership Updates & Audience Trends

Esports Charts, the leading esports analytics platform, has been nominated for "Esports Supporting Service of the Year" at the Esports Awards 2026. The category recognizes companies that provide essential services helping organizations, tournaments, teams, and other stakeholders succeed across the esports industry.

The Esports Awards is one of the industry's most prestigious annual events, celebrating excellence across competitive gaming. Following last year's nomination forEsports Supporting Platform of the Year, Esports Charts has once again been recognized, this time in the newly introducedEsports Supporting Service of the Yearcategory.

"Our mission hasn't changed since day one: to make esports data easier to access, understand, and act on,"said Artyom Odintsov, CEO & Co-founder of Esports Charts. "Whether it's making industry-leading metrics like Media Value publicly available for tournaments, creating a dedicated Viewership Hub for the Esports World Cup, or launching the Global Esports Map, every initiative we build is driven by the same goal — to give everyone in the esports ecosystem better tools to understand audiences, measure impact, and make informed decisions. We're honored to see that long-term commitment recognized by the Esports Awards."

Fans and industry professionals can cast their votes daily for the Esports Awards 2026 through the official voting page. Voting is now open and will remain available untilNovember 10th, 2026, with the winners to be announced during the Esports Awards ceremony held in Miami, USA, later this year.

Esports Charts has been recognized by the Esports Awards on multiple occasions. The company wonEsports Coverage Platform of the Yearin 2023, was nominated in the same category in 2024, earned a nomination forEsports Coverage Platform of the Decadein 2025, was shortlisted forEsports Supporting Platform of the Yearthat same year, and now joins the nominees forEsports Supporting Service of the Yearin 2026.

title: Most-watched esports team of July 2026: T1 takes top spot after appearing in four events
summary: Most-watched esports team of July 2026: T1 takes top spot after appearing in four events  Esports Charts
content:
LIVE Viewership Updates & Audience Trends

During a monthwhen fans got to witness two global championships,League of Legendsteams dominated the rankings of the most-watched teamsin July 2026.T1ended up taking the top spot, playing more matches than any other side in the top ten while accumulating 31.03 million Hours Watched.

T1 outperformed the next-best side by 31.2%, although a fewMobile Legends: Bang Bangsides attracted higher peak and average live viewers last month.

T1 played as many as four different tournaments last month, kicking July 2026 off by continuing itsMid-Season Invitational 2026journey. The three-time reigning world champion beatTeam Liquid3:0 in the final Play-In Stage match to ensure it qualified for the Bracket Stage.

This was the first of its 17 games last month, but things didn't quite work out in terms of tangible rewards. T1 played a further three matches at MSI 2026, including a thrilling series againstBilibili Gamingthat ended 2:3 in favor of the Chinese side, contributing almost 25% to the team's July HW total.

A shock loss toG2 Esportsin the Lower Bracket Round 2 saw T1 exit early in the Bracket Stage, although this game reached 2.3 million Peak Viewers, the most popular series at the mid-season championship. T1's early eliminationdid impact MSI 2026's viewership, as theLoL competitionrecorded a noticeable year-over-year decline compared with the record-setting 2025 edition.
